skillLayoutCodex: Codex uses directory skills: each skill is a ~/.codex/skills/<name>/ folder with SKILL.md as the entry file.
skillLayoutClaude: Claude Code uses slash commands: each command is a ~/.claude/commands/<name>.md file.
skillStatusCodexReady: Codex CLI was detected; Codex skills are installed.
skillStatusClaudeReady: Claude Code CLI was detected; Claude commands are installed.
skillClaudeCliMissing: Claude Code CLI was not detected.
skillCodexFilesMissing: Codex skills are not fully installed:
skillClaudeFilesMissing: Claude commands are not fully installed:
skillOnlyOneAgentNote: You only need to install and select the one Agent you plan to use.
statusNote: Ready for TXT, EPUB, prompt generation, report-to-HTML review, and the interactive Agent Console.
companionGuideLine1: Yaona offers guidance: choose the source file and output folder first. Source files stay read-only.
companionGuideLine2: Set the language pair, style, output folders, and split size in Advanced.
companionGuideLine3: For proofreading, choose split or Monte Carlo. Monte Carlo keeps subagents off.
requiredSourceOutput: Source file and output folder are required.
requiredReviewReport: Review report and output folder are required.
agentUnavailable: Agent Console could not start. Check that Codex / Claude Code is installed and available in PATH.
agentConsoleInput: Type a command or message for the agent
agentConsoleNeedsOutput: Output folder is required before opening the Agent Console.
promptSentToAgent: Prompt sent to the Agent Console.
promptSentViaFile: Prompt is long, so it was saved to a file and sent as a file reference:
projectOpenedNoHtml: Project folder selected, but no recent HTML was found. Open an HTML file manually or generate one.
reviewFormatFallback: The AI report failed format validation. A repair prompt was generated.
reviewHtmlOpened: Review HTML opened inside the app.
sourceImmutable: Source files are read-only and never modified. Prompts require backup before overwriting translations.
modeTranslateOnly: Without a translation file, this is translation-only mode.
modeCompare: With a translation file, this is proofreading / comparison mode.
